customPacks.newSubtitle: Use free AI to generate words for any theme. The whole process takes about two minutes.
customPacks.guideStep1: Name your pack — pick a title and optional description for the theme.
customPacks.guideStep2: Copy our ready-made prompt and paste it into ChatGPT or Claude.
customPacks.guideStep3: Copy the AI's full reply and paste it into the box on this page.
customPacks.guideStep4: Save your pack, then select it from Word Packs when you host a game.
customPacks.stepNameBody: The title tells the AI what theme to generate. A short description helps if the title alone is vague.
customPacks.stepGenerateBody: We build a custom prompt from your title. Copy it, open a free AI chat, paste the prompt, and send. The AI will return a long list of words — that output is what you'll paste back in step 3.
customPacks.aiToolsHint: Both have free tiers. You don't need a paid plan for this.
customPacks.copyPromptDisabled: Enter a pack title in step 1 first.
customPacks.copyPromptHint: After copying, paste the prompt into the AI chat and send it. Then copy the AI's entire reply.
customPacks.stepPasteBody: Select all of the AI's response and paste it below. It will look like code starting with [{\\

howToPlay.intro: Taboo is a word-guessing party game. One player (the Explainer) describes a target word to their teammates without saying the forbidden taboo words, word parts, rhymes, or gestures.
howToPlay.howItWorks: Teams take turns. The Explainer's teammates type guesses in the chat. The opposing team watches for violations and can buzz if a taboo word is said.
howToPlay.scoringCorrectExplainer: Correct guess — earn the word's difficulty (1–6 pts)
howToPlay.scoringSkipExplainer: Explainer skips a word, no points
howToPlay.dialogQuickSixLine1Explainer: Correct guess — earn that word’s points (shown on the card).
howToPlay.dialogQuickSixLine2Explainer: Taboo words aren’t shown; the buzzer isn’t used in Quick Six.
howToPlay.dialogQuickSixLine3Explainer: Finish all six words before the timer runs out.
howToPlay.winner: The team with the most points at the end of all rounds wins!
howToPlay.page.title: How to Play Taboo
howToPlay.page.shortIntro: One person describes the word. Everyone else guesses in chat. Do not say the taboo words, chunks of the answer, or rhymes.
howToPlay.page.badClueText: Saying “sun”—it’s hiding inside “sunflower,” even if it’s not on the taboo list.
howToPlay.page.goodClueText: Tall farm crop grown for seeds; huge round head on a long stalk.
howToPlay.page.rulesSummary: Type guesses in chat. A correct guess scores 1–6. You can skip a word for zero points.
howToPlay.page.oneTeamBlurb: Best for small groups: one Explainer, everyone guesses. No buzzer—just agree on mistakes.
howToPlay.page.twoTeamBlurb: Needs four or more: Red vs Blue. Rivals listen and buzz taboo slips.
howToPlay.page.classicModeBlurb: Timed turns with taboo words. In two teams, rivals can buzz.
howToPlay.page.quickSixBlurb: Six words per turn, each worth 1–6 points. No taboo list and no skips—finish all six before time runs out.
howToPlay.page.quickSixDemoNote: Like in-game: six cards, no taboos, no skip.
howToPlay.page.quickSixGridTagline: Describe each word without saying the actual word —
howToPlay.page.cta: Ready to put your skills to the test?
